config.name: Astro Mitra Copy Guidelines
config.source: Earlier Mitra / Fulfillment field-user discussions and copywriting scope (Aug-Nov 2026), not a finalized Mitra guideline document
config.note: This is a pilot-enabled copy of the original draft. Source provenance and unresolved validation remain in the domain metadata. Approval does not verify operational/business facts. Preserve original draft unchanged.
config.approvalScope: Internal trial only; user-authorized 2026-11-26. Does not constitute BPI, Brand, Ops, Legal, or organizational policy signoff.

sharedGlobalFoundation.note: Use existing global copy principles as reference; do not carry over the Supplier-specific glossary, Supplier/Vendor naming mandate, or rules to Mitra.

mitra.label: Mitra
mitra.audience: Operational/field users in relevant Fulfillment experiences; confirm exact roles, workflows and terminology for each feature.
mitra.scope: Task-based UI copy, SOP, Work Instructions, OJT/training and operational announcements. Broader Mitra channels require validation before rollout.

reviewPolicy.drafts: Historical v0.1.0 draft remains archived; this v0.1.1 file enables test usage, with content subject to review.
reviewPolicy.nonFabrication: Never invent operational steps, scan requirements, exceptions, SLA, escalation policies, permissions or ownership.
reviewPolicy.userContext: Check the real user role, current task, object and next action; don't assume every Mitra workflow matches Fulfillment or WMS.
reviewPolicy.pilotApproval: All domain guidelines activated for user-led internal trial on 2026-11-26. Formal policy signoff is not established.
reviewPolicy.scopeNotes: Guidelines are stylistic/research-derived pilot heuristics; do not treat them as evidence of business behavior.

toneReference.source: Earlier Fulfillment field feedback + UX Writing Playbook (1).zip / 2.4. Our Tone.pdf
toneReference.proposedDirection: Simple, straightforward and task-focused; more serious than Buyer in operational or error contexts.
toneReference.provenance: Provisional adaptation of Fulfillment product tone, not a signed-off Mitra-specific voice policy.

guidelines.name: Make the task and next action explicit.
guidelines.rule: Tell users what to do, on which object, and what outcome to expect when those details are confirmed. Avoid vague generic instructions.
guidelines.evidence: Prior Fulfillment/Mitra field findings emphasized direct task-focused copy.

guidelines.name: Match instructions to the current workflow step.
guidelines.rule: Communicate the relevant condition or state before the action only when necessary. Don't assume an operational state not confirmed by the actual flow.
guidelines.evidence: Operational task context changes the meaning of instructions.

guidelines.name: Make errors actionable.
guidelines.rule: State the actual problem and recovery action when known. If cause or recovery is unknown, ask for more context instead of inventing a fix.
guidelines.evidence: Field users need error reasons and recovery to continue work.

guidelines.name: Use familiar field terminology.
guidelines.rule: Prefer terms the relevant operational users understand; avoid unexplained internal English/system jargon. Keep official or widely used terms when they are genuinely understood.
guidelines.evidence: Unfamiliar English and internal vocabulary created confusion in prior user conversations.

guidelines.name: Make SOP, WI and OJT instructions easy to follow.
guidelines.rule: Organize work instructions into clear, ordered actions and meaningful checkpoints where the actual procedure supports them. Avoid adding steps, thresholds or exceptions that are not verified.
guidelines.evidence: User requested a cross-channel guideline for SOP, Working Instructions, announcements and training.

guidelines.name: Explain operational statuses when needed.
guidelines.rule: Use status copy that conveys the actual work state and what happens next or who acts next, when confirmed and relevant. Don't imply completion or next actions without evidence.
guidelines.evidence: Task-state interpretation and next steps matter in operations.

guidelines.name: Keep instructions concise and scannable.
guidelines.rule: Use short, direct sentences and grouping that are usable during active work. Avoid burying the action in long explanatory copy.
guidelines.evidence: Field feedback emphasized speed, clarity and reduced cognitive load.

guidelines.name: Reduce avoidable dependence on SPV clarification.
guidelines.rule: State enough context so users can act without unnecessary follow-up, but preserve any real escalation requirement. Do not invent or remove escalation rules.
guidelines.evidence: Confusing copy was discussed as a cause of extra SPV questions and delays.

guidelines.name: Treat workflow or placement problems as UX issues.
guidelines.rule: If the missing information or action placement cannot be fixed by copy alone, flag the UX/workflow problem instead of making up text.
guidelines.evidence: Shared Global Foundation plus operational field context; proposed domain application.
